bullets: New: Full screen. Press the corners button at the top right. Messages, Ops Guide and Settings sit in a bar on the left, and resource cards spread across the page. Keep the side pane open: it still plays the sound.
New: Light and dark mode. Press the sun / moon at the top right; this computer remembers your choice.
Changed: Refresh is now the circular arrow at the top right, next to full screen and light/dark.
Changed: The Dev updates bell is only in full screen, right of the name at the top left. A red dot means something new; click the bell to read it. Nothing pops up on its own.
Changed: The Dev Update bell floats again. Drag it anywhere; it starts at the bottom right.
New: When you open Relay, it shows what it's reading from the workbook, then asks you to enter your name. Pick yours, or add it if you're new. This computer remembers you for the rest of the day.
New: Your name shows under the title. Use Switch user if someone else takes over. When you press Got it on a message, it says your name.
Changed: "Who's using this computer?" is now "Who is this computer for?": the front desk, or a clinician or device. Messages still go out under that.
New: The bell next to Refresh keeps a list of what's changed. Hover over either button to see what it does.
